summary: Audited tests/providers.rs lines 1-750 for false-pass patterns. All 16 tests reviewed; no assertion-free, tautological, implementation-mirroring, or ignored-assertion tests found. findings: [].

files.description: Read lines 1-752 in full: glob_routing, route_model, anthropic/gemini/responses translation tests, parallel tool-result folding, v1 routing tests, SSE finish_reason ordering, compat flag tests, SecretRef command test, discovered-model routing.

architecture: Tests run at three levels: pure-function units (glob_match, route_model, SecretRef) with bidirectional asserts; Provider::new against a local axum mock over real HTTP (mock does not bypass actual serialization/parsing); and api::router oneshot end-to-end checks that also inspect the captured upstream request body.
report: Per-test verdicts: glob_routing includes negative case. route_model checks prefix, glob, and fallback paths with values. anthropic translation test asserts captured request (system extraction, cache_control, fs__read mangling, roles) and response translation; goes through real wire serialization. thinking-replay asserts block position, thinking/signature values, and following block order (unasserted text content is a coverage note, not a false pass). gemini translation is minimal but has real assertions. Both parallel-fold tests verify no consecutive same-role via windows(2) plus per-block counts, ids, types. v1_routes asserts status, body, upstream model, and thinking field. thinking-disable test is a real negative assertion (is_none). finish_reason ordering uses first-occurrence find comparison, fails on violation. responses translation asserts per-type mapping, max_output_tokens, usage. compat_flags asserts rename, absent old field, developer role, id normalization, tool_result name/id match. coalesce asserts count and merged content. command_secret tests success value and failure is_err. discovered routing uses dead default provider and asserts captured.len()==1. Conclusion: no false-pass tests; zero findings. Clean areas (dedup material for next audit): glob_match units, route_model, anthropic request/response translation, thinking replay, gemini translation, parallel folding (anthropic/gemini), v1 routing with thinking suffix, thinking-disable regression, SSE finish_reason/[DONE] ordering, responses translation, compat flags, system-message coalescing, SecretRef command success/failure, discovered-model routing.
